name: nid-mcpb
description: Nid's Claude Desktop extension (#309): mcp-remote, the bridge from Claude Desktop's stdio to Nid's /mcp, vendored into the image with npm ci so its tarballs are pinned by hash. Claude Desktop puts the token in NID_AUTH; mcp-remote expands ${NID_AUTH} in its header itself, so the token never reaches the command line. The host zips this folder with the manifest filled in for the instance (GET /api/v1/mcp/nid.mcpb).
